name: night-shift
description: Overnight batch runner: queue tasks before bed, a declared auto-approval policy lets safe operations (edits in allowed dirs, tests, linters, scratch-branch commits) run unattended, ask-tier operations (payment, send-message, publish, purchase) stop with a clear ASK line and an 'asked' status instead of running, anything risky parks with a reason, and a morning digest reports what finished, asked, parked, or failed. Never pushes, never auto-approves outside the policy.
